zh.explain: 高翔的鸾凤被雨淋湿了羽翼，反而被蓬间的雀鸟欺侮。但一切终究会有云开雨霁的时候，到时仍能重振羽翼胜过百鸟。
divination: 周围的小人日渐得志，是君子便不要强行有所作为。
只宜坚守本性，等待时机来临时才去一展身手。
items: 宜多防护，注意调养身体
坚持努力而有更大成就
zh.summary: 此卦鸾凤被雨之象。所祈求之事需等待时机的来临，必定会顺利。

verse: The phoenix‘s distinguished feathers soak with rain,
Even the common bird mock and laugh at him.
Suddenly the rains cease and the sky is clear again,
Its plumage continues to be a regal feather robe.
interpretation: When vile people call the shots, you should do nothing but retreat and wait until things are in your favor again.
meaning: A majestic bird is soaked in the rain.
Wait for a more favorable moment to come.
en.explain: The soaring phoenix's feathers were drenched by the rain, they were even mocked by the common birds in the canopy. But these will pass when the rain stops and the sky clears, then they will once again revive their regal feathers to regain their position above all other birds.
divination: As vile people around you grow more ambitious day by day, a gentleman like you should not impose your standards or force your way through. Instead, it is better to stick to your own duty and wait for the right opportunity to display your skills.
items: Take more care  and pay attention to regulate your body
Continue to work hard and get greater achievements

notes: 18 items incl. 迁徙搬家 / Migrating/moving house. EN verse line 1 prints a left single quote in phoenix‘s (kept). EN Birth value has a double space ('care  and') as printed.
